items:
Nestled in the heart of Miramar Beach, Ravens Run within Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort offers an idyllic retreat for your next getaway. This 1,847 square foot, two-story vacation rental can comfortably accommodate up to eight guests. Featuring three spacious bedrooms and four well-appointed bathrooms, this property has everything you need for a memorable stay. The master bedroom boasts a luxurious queen bed, while the second bedroom also offers a queen bed for added comfort. The third bedroom has a set of twin bunk beds, perfect for families or friends traveling together.

This home includes a golf cart so you don't have to walk to the beach and you can bring the whole family including your dog! This pet friendly home allows up to 2 dogs 35 pounds or less for an additional pet fee.

Upon entering, you're greeted by a sleek, modern open-concept living area with ample natural light. The living room, with its plush sofas and smart TV, is perfect for unwinding after a day of adventure. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to prepare delicious meals, including a refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, and all necessary dishes and utensils.

A highlight of this property is the outdoor living space, featuring a private patio with a seating area, perfect for enjoying the Florida sunshine or stargazing at night. The resort amenities are second to none, with a sparkling community pool, a hot tub, and a fitness room to keep you active during your stay. Free Wi-Fi ensures you stay connected, while air conditioning and heating provide comfort year-round.

Explore the vibrant local scene with easy access to some of Miramar Beach’s best attractions. Just a short drive away, you can spend a day at the pristine beaches, perfect for sunbathing or water activities. Golf enthusiasts will love the nearby Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort, where you can tee off on world-class courses.

Whether you're looking to relax by the pool, explore the beautiful beaches, or indulge in some local shopping and dining, Ravens Run provides the perfect blend of luxury and comfort. Book your stay today and experience the charm of Miramar Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description:
Located in Laurel Grove, a neighborhood in Miramar Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and near the beach. While the natural beauty of Miramar Beach and Destin Beaches can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Big Kahuna's Water and Adventure Park and Blast Arcade and Laser Maze are also worth visiting. With jet skiing, snorkeling, and parasailing nearby, you'll find plenty of adventures in the water.
